Flavio '''"vOn"''' Di Lego is a Brazilian amateur player, nowadays living in Europe. He's been around since [[2010]], but there's been quite a few comings and goings.

He first found the game through his older brother, who didn't continue to play, leaving the addiction over to the younger brother. Beginning on a 250 ping modem connection, he created a passion and was never able to stop playing.

vOn is primarily a [[duel]] player, well known by his [[LG]] aim, but enjoys a good [[2on2]] here and there.
